name: a ranked ledger names the dead and the worthless
looks: Under a two-part headline stating a zero rate and a dead-item count, a short ranked table builds row by row: a rank, an anonymised source, a status pill and a value. Rows with a bad status (no link, dead) are tinted in the warning colour, their value zeroed out, so the worst offenders are immediately visible.
build: Rows reveal top to bottom on a 0.06-0.09s stagger, y:6px->0, power2.out; bad-status rows get a tinted pill, a warning-coloured value and a faint background strip. The headline above lands just before the first row.
sound: A dry tick per row, a slightly harder tick on each bad-status row.
prompt: State the worst finding as a blunt two-line headline, then build a short ranked table underneath it: a rank, a label, a status pill and a value, landing row by row. Tint the worst rows in a warning colour so the damage is legible without reading every cell.
